identity.title: Pokémon XD: Whirlwind of Darkness, Dark Lugia (manga walkthrough)

leadText:
(Japanese: ポケモンＸＤ 闇の旋風ダーク・ルギア Pokémon XD: Whirlwind of Darkness, Dark Lugia) is a walkthrough of the Pokémon XD: Gale of Darkness game. It was created by Emiko Yoshino (Japanese: よしのえみこの).
